title: Lake Natron (Tanzania) – 2017-03-06 (very early in rainy season) – satellite image (cropped).jpg
author: Joshua Stevens/NASA
description: Lake Natron and surroundings in northern Arusha Region, Tanzania. It is located in the East African Rift. The lake is mostly inhospitable to life, except for a few species adapted to its warm, salty, and alkaline water.
